description: This file contains utility functions for internationalization (i18n), hashing, environment variable handling, and string normalization within a workflow/code generation project. It provides functions for generating cache keys, normalizing and hashing texts, determining provider and model configurations based on environment variables, and segment ID generation.

methods.name: cacheNamespace
methods.description: Generates a namespace string for caching purposes based on workflow version, engine name, provider, and model.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash key combining namespace, language codes, segment ID, and text hash.

methods.name: hashText
methods.description: Returns a SHA256 hash of the normalized input text.

methods.name: hashBytes
methods.description: Returns a SHA256 hash of a byte array.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims and reduces multiple whitespace characters in text to single spaces.

methods.name: docsPiProvider
methods.description: Determines the provider name based on environment variables and defaults.

methods.name: docsPiModel
methods.description: Returns the model name based on environment variables and provider.

methods.name: segmentID
methods.description: Creates a segment identifier combining relative path and short text hash.

methods.name: splitWhitespace
methods.description: Splits the input string into whitespace, middle, and trailing parts.

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a byte character is whitespace.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Prints an error message and terminates the program if an error is provided.
